messages:
Leah: Quick coordination thread for the on-prem HW + marketplace bundle: Snowflake + Databricks connectors + Pinecone/Qdrant adapter running on partner appliances. Partner legal wants the joint support matrix and a single-day go-live window. Can eng confirm support matrix and SLA implications?
Omar: From infra side: the appliance images are good, but we need to validate GPU passthrough on partner 2.0 firmware. I can run fw smoke tomorrow.
Vikram: Connector compatibility matrix: Snowflake 6.x OK, Databricks runtime 11+ OK, Pinecone adapter uses v1 HTTP API (we've tested). Edge case: older Qdrant builds need rebuild for AVX512.
Sofia: Marketing asks: one combined marketplace listing or separate tiles per partner? Partners prefer a combined "Edge Vector Bundle" listing that shows certified hardware + connectors. We need a 120x120 icon and a short blurb.
Leah: Combined listing is preferred by partners. Also need a short partner quote from SI (they promised one). Can someone chase them?
Marcom: I'll draft the blurb. Need three bullet value props (on-prem low-latency, turnkey GPU bundle, enterprise telemetry). Also need link to install runbook.
Vikram: Dev note: when deploying on appliance, set `--kv-cache=on` and `--batch-size=512` for best throughput. Add to runbook.
QA-bot: Preflight check: appliance-firmware-2.0 -> WARN (GPU passthrough tests pending). connector-integration -> PASS (smoke). telemetry-hook -> PASS.
Omar: I'll schedule a passthrough test `fw-verify-2.0.sh` against partner image tonight. If it fails, fallback plan is to use partner image 1.8 with software muxing.
Sofia: For announcement timing, partner marketing asked for a week lead. If we want launch on March 14, assets must be final by EOD next Wed.
Leah: Risks: 1) firmware flakiness (Omar) 2) Qdrant AVX builds 3) legal sign-off on joint SLA. Assign owners?
Omar: I'll own 1. Will ping partner infra lead.
Vikram: I'll own 2. Plan: rebuild Qdrant with generic flags and test perf delta.
Leah: I'll chase legal on SLA item and SI quote.
Marcom: Asset checklist I'm tracking: 
- 120x120 icon (Marcom)
- 1 hero screenshot (product)
- 30s demo gif (product + eng)
- Install runbook link (eng)
- Partner quote (partnerships)
- Joint SLA blurb (legal)
Target: deliver package as `edge-bundle-v1.zip` into artifacts.
Vikram: Small technical ask for docs: include this example env var for on-prem deployments:
```
export REDWOOD_ONPREM_MODE=1
export CONNECTOR_BACKEND=pinecone,qdrant
```
Sofia: Also need a short troubleshooting snippet for the common issue where local firewall blocks the adapter: `ufw allow 8080/tcp && systemctl restart redwood-adapter`
QA-bot: New test run scheduled: `connector-integration-nightly -> 1736668000`
Omar: Passthrough test queued -> https://ci.redwood.local/build/fw-pt-901
Leah: Two asks before we close this thread: 1) Omar 12 run and confirm fw passthrough by tomorrow noon, 2) Vickram 12 upload Qdrant build results and perf numbers. Marketing will prep draft once we have green.
Vikram: Will upload build artifacts to https://artifacts.redwood/internal/qdrant-edge-1736667777.tar.gz and perf CSV.
Marcom: Draft blurb (WIP): "Edge Vector Bundle: Turnkey on-prem vector search with Redwood connectors for Snowflake and Databricks, certified on partner appliances for deterministic latency." Will iterate.
Leah: Thanks all. If firmware passes and legal signs SLA, partner comms window looks realistic. Ping me for any blockers. :rocket:
